mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was most worthwhile because the slipping-and-correction sequence brought touch, nerves and muscles together in a familiar action.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the supporting layer to the surface barrier was a predictable assembly step. The resulting vessel inset added useful information, though the combination itself held little uncertainty.

surprise.text: The connected surface cells still allowed water to escape, making the outer layer's separate role clearer.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt particularly arbitrary; the item titles and picture descriptions gave each a plausible purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter developed similarly concrete interactions between body systems. This chapter's final feedback loop was more engaging to me than the straightforward layer assembly.
